core.VOO: broad large-cap, S&P 500, cap-weighted, Vanguard share class of the same index as SPY
core.VTI: total US market, cap-weighted, broader than the S&P 500 alone
core.QQQM: large-cap growth, Nasdaq-100, cap-weighted -- lower-fee share class of QQQ, named in note p.11
core.DIA: large-cap, Dow 30, price-weighted (mechanically different from the cap-weighted funds above)
core.RSP: S&P 500 equal-weight -- same constituents as SPY, different weighting scheme

themes.SOXX: semiconductors -- note p.11's own named list
themes.SMH: semiconductors -- larger, more mega-cap-concentrated alternative to SOXX
themes.XBI: biotech, equal-weighted (mechanically distinct from cap-weighted sector funds)
themes.ARKK: actively-managed disruptive-growth theme, structurally different turnover/concentration profile

non_equity.EFA: developed-market ex-US equity, MSCI EAFE (older, more liquid alternative to VEA)
non_equity.BND: broad US bond market, cap-weighted aggregate
non_equity.AGG: broad US bond market, cap-weighted aggregate -- near-duplicate of BND by construction, kept to test that claim measurably

leveraged.QLD: 2x QQQ daily-reset -- note p.11's own named leveraged pick

singles.TSLA: mega-cap, added -- top index-weight name, notably higher-volatility than the other five
